units: <cite ref="Berakhot 28b:9">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אֵיסוּרוֹ א׳ עולם</he> the imprisonment which he decrees is not everlasting (as he may die and his successor may relieve me).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> he burst the prison open <he>והוציא האיסו׳</he> (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">ib.</cite> also <he>האֵיסָרִין</he>) and set the prisoners free [prob. to be read <he>אסירין</he>].
